brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
Zambia's opposition leader has been charged with attempting to overthrow the government. [1][2]
Zambia recorded 60 new cholera cases and two deaths. [5]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR ZAMBIA
The charge against the opposition leader may heighten political tensions in Zambia, even as the country's most severe government travel advisory remains Exercise Normal Precautions. [1][2][E1]

KEY RISKS
Zambia is linked to 5 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations, as of Nov 24, 2026. [E2]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the opposition leader will be tried or acquitted on the charge of attempting to overthrow the government. [1][2]
Whether the cholera outbreak in Zambia will be contained or spread further. [5]
